verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents 750+ integrations, incident management from Slack, a chat experience in Slack and Microsoft Teams, and SRE Agent analysis of code in GitHub, so the core integration story is real. However, only Slack shows evidence of two-way state flow, and Jira and Zoom are never named. Missing for 10: any documented Jira integration or bidirectional ticket sync, a named Zoom integration, two-way GitHub sync (the evidence shows read-only code analysis), explicit two-way state sync for Teams, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, the platform integrates with the tools around the incident — Jira, Slack, Teams, Zoom, GitHub — so state flows both ways

citations.quote: With 750+ platform integrations, PagerDuty is a leader in connecting tools, data, and AI to your incident management process.
Manage incidents and coordinate response from Slack or your IDE.
Chat experience in Slack and Microsoft Teams
the SRE Agent can intelligently deduce the next steps for troubleshooting issues by analyzing code within GitHub
Teams can start PIRs directly from the incident detail page or Slack after resolving an incident
